[[Noritoshi Kamo]] |clan=[[Kamo Clan]] }} '''Blood Manipulation''' is an inherited cursed technique of the [[Kamo Clan]] that lets its user control their own blood and anything it touches. ==Abilities== Users can harden, accelerate and shape their blood into projectiles, the strongest of which is called Piercing Blood.

'''Limitless''' ({{nihongo||無下限呪術|Mukagen Jujutsu}}) is an inherited [[cursed technique]] of the [[Gojo Clan]], wielded in the present day by [[Satoru Gojo]].<ref>Chapter 15</ref>

==Overview==
Limitless allows the user to bring the concept of infinity, taken from mathematics, into reality, slowing down anything that approaches them.

===Infinity===
Infinity is a neutral application of the technique that places an endless series of points between the user and an attacker.

===Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue===
Blue amplifies the technique to create a point of attraction that pulls everything nearby towards it.

==Trivia==
* The technique's name is often shortened to "Mukagen".

'''Unlimited Void''' ({{nihongo|Unlimited Void|無量空処|Muryōkūsho}}) is the [[Domain Expansion]] of [[Satoru Gojo]], an endless interior of outer space.

==Sure-hit Effect==
Anyone trapped inside the domain is bombarded with an endless amount of information, leaving them unable to act.

The '''Shibuya Incident Arc''' is the eighth story arc of ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. On Halloween, a curtain falls over [[Shibuya]] and the city becomes the battlefield between sorcerers and a coalition of curses.

==Summary==
The arc begins when a curtain is lowered around Shibuya Station, trapping civilians inside.

'''Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School''', commonly called Tokyo Jujutsu High, is one of the two jujutsu schools in Japan, training young sorcerers while posing as a religious school.

'''Tokyo''' ({{lang-ja|東京}}) is the capital of Japan and the home of [[Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School|Tokyo Jujutsu High]].
